1.author: agent
1.text: Added public API/options/error contracts test-first; focused suite plus full refc and ORC suites pass. Empty and mem:// factories work, unknown schemes raise InvalidBackendUrlError, lifecycle is idempotent, and the documented abstract surface type-checks.

2.author: agent
2.text: Added focused memory KV contract tests and InMemoryKvStore. Verified missing/empty distinction, binary-safe round trips, overwrite, delete booleans, exists agreement, and empty-key validation. Focused tests and full refc/ORC suites pass without network.

3.author: agent
3.text: Implemented lazy TTL with an injected monotonic clock seam. Deterministic tests cover persistent entries, positive expiry, overwrite resetting TTL, negative TTL preserving the old value, and expired get/exists/increment behavior. Focused and full refc/ORC suites pass.

4.author: agent
4.text: Implemented bounded deterministic LRU with read/overwrite recency refresh, expired-entry purge before eviction, lexical key tie-break, and positive-capacity validation. Focused tests explicitly cover every criterion; full refc and ORC suites pass.

5.author: agent
5.text: Implemented signed 64-bit atomic increments without awaits between read/write. Tests cover missing→1, monotonic and negative values, int64 boundary behavior, invalid/overflow preservation, and 200 interleaved increments. Focused plus refc/ORC suites pass.

6.author: agent
6.text: Implemented snapshot-based in-process Pub/Sub with unique opaque subscriptions, exact routing/counts, idempotent unsubscribe, ordered per-subscription queues, callback-safe subscription mutation, isolated/redacted handler errors, and close-time task draining. Focused plus refc/ORC suites pass.

7.author: agent
7.text: Completed lifecycle/state behavior: immediate connected and terminal closed notifications, no memory disconnect states, typed post-close failures, idempotent close, active worker cancellation-and-drain, and subscription shutdown. Focused lifecycle tests and full refc/ORC suites pass.

8.author: agent
8.text: Extracted reusable factory-driven KV and Pub/Sub contract suites under tests/contract. Memory now runs portable behavior only through those harnesses; memory-specific tests cover injected-clock/LRU/cancellation internals. A deliberately broken KV fake is detected across missing-get, round-trip, delete, and increment probes. Full refc/ORC suites pass.
